survey: A carved jack-o'-lantern sits on a wooden plank table in front of a purple sunburst. The camera is a little above the pumpkin and slightly to its front. The pumpkin is a squat, ribbed sphere. Its top shows a little, and the ribs bunch toward the stem at the top and curve back toward the base, as a sphere seen slightly from above should look. The green stem rises from the top centre and leans a little to the right. Its cut end is a tilted ellipse seen from above, which matches the pumpkin's view. The face (two triangle eyes and a zigzag mouth) is carved into the front surface. The face lines bow slightly with the curve of the pumpkin, as they should when seen from just above. The cut walls inside each opening show on the lower edges, which is the side you would see from above. The table planks run left to right, parallel to the table's back edge, which slopes down slightly to the right. The table recedes from the same raised view. The pumpkin's flattened base rests on the table, with a contact shadow falling to the right and behind it. All parts agree on one camera.
